text:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's CUDA 13.2 + driver 535 rollout to us-west1-gpu-pool we're seeing jobs with big p2p transfers silently dropping to NET instead of NVLink/SHM. Throughput down ~3-4x on some T4/H100 mixed runs. Anyone else seeing this?

raj: yeah I've seen a couple failing jobs but assumed a scheduler quirk. Which nodes affected?

maria: Looks like mixed-node pods (older A100s + newer H100s in the same allocation) are the worst. Single-gen allocations look fine. Example job id: rjob-20260315-88.

alex: posting a short NCCL log from that job: 
```
NCCL WARN NET/0 : Unable to allocate transport for peer X, falling back to socket
NCCL INFO p2p : peer 2 -> 3 topology lookup failed, falling back to NET
NCCL WARN SHM : no valid ipc path for peer 1, disabling SHM
```
Not super verbose but consistent pattern.

ken: Can you paste nvidia-smi topo -m from one of the problem hosts? We need to know if NVLink edges are reported.

maria: Sure — grabbed from node gpu-a100-03 (mixed job allocated across gpu-a100-03 and gpu-h100-11):
```
# nvidia-smi topo -m
GPU0	GPU1	CPU Affinity
GPU0	X	NVLINK	PHB
GPU1	NVLINK	X	PHB
```
From gpu-h100-11 it shows NVLINK too, but when both hosts in a pod we see mismatched matrices.

raj: weird. Could be driver/kernel mismatch causing NVLink link not being exposed across PCI or NVSwitch differences across SKUs. Any dmesg or kernel taints?

maria: dmesg snippet from gpu-h100-11 after job start:
```
[ 1234.567] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: GPU topology initialization failed: NVLINK not found
[ 1234.570] nvidia: probe of 0000:65:00.0 failed with error -22
```

ops-bot: deploy 1769994300 completed: cuda-13.2 image rolled to us-west1-gpu-pool at 2026-03-15T02:05Z :white_check_mark:

alex: Also saw kernel module reload times differ. On affected nodes, nvidia.ko seems to lose nvlink attributes after modprobe: 
```
# cat /sys/module/nvidia/parameters/p2p
0
```
which should be 1.

ken: Hmm. Are we running custom kernel (internal perf builds) or stock distro kernels in that pool? I recall we tested 13.2 on stock but didn't on the perf kernels.

maria: Mixed — some hosts got the perf-kernel-6.6.4 (for lower latency) and others stayed on 6.5.10 because of earlier rollback. So yes, kernel versions are mixed.

raj: That matches: NVLink detection relies on certain IOMMU/pci hotplug behaviors fixed in kernel driver path. If kernels differ, module initialization can skip NVLINK. Could explain why single-gen allocations (on same kernel) are fine.

maria: Work plan proposal: 1) Drain affected mixed-node pool ties 2) Revert driver on recently upgraded hosts to 525.x or re-align kernels 3) Run a focused repro with NCCL tests + nvidia-smi topo -m and NCCL_DEBUG=INFO 4) Engage NVIDIA if repro replicates. Thoughts?

alex: +1. Before reverting, can we run the NCCL p2p test on a repro pair with envs to force verbose logging? Something like:
```
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=INIT,GRAPH,P2P,SHM python tests/p2p_allreduce.py --gpus 2
```
Collect /var/log/messages and dmesg.

ken: Also collect /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/*/infor (the vendor-provided topology info) and output of lspci -vv for the GPUs. I'll make a small script to gather those and push to /tmp/harvest-1769994321.tar.gz.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-02 (P2P NVLINK regress after cuda/driver rollout). Severity: P2. Pager duty: on-call-sre.

maria: Ran a quick controlled test (two hosts, same job) with NCCL_DEBUG=INFO and here's the interesting bit:
```
[INFO] NCCL P2P: attempted NVLINK setup between 0000:65:00.0 and 0000:af:00.0 -> topology mismatch, using NET
[INFO] NCCL SHM: ipc open failed: Permission denied for path /dev/shm/nccl-...
```
Permission denied on /dev/shm — but the container had correct seccomp and IPC settings. Could be kernel SELinux changes on some nodes?

raj: Did the container runtime change? We switched runc -> crun in a canary last week for some hosts which had different IPC namespace defaults.

maria: Good catch — gpu-h100-11 is on crun, gpu-a100-03 still runc. I'll try identical runtime on both to see.

alex: If runtime difference explains SHM, NVLink still weird. I think two axes: 1) kernel/driver mismatch hides NVLINK (topology) 2) runtime IPC/security prevents SHM. Combined -> fallback to NET.

ken: For immediate mitigation: we can mark mixed-gen scheduling as disabled (affinity rule) so pods are pinned to same-sku until we stabilize. Also tag nodes with kernel+driver version metadata so scheduler can avoid mixing.

maria: I'll open a k8s node-affinity short-term change and roll back cuda-driver on the perf-kernel hosts to 525.x tonight. Will run repro tests after.

ops-bot: @maria scheduled node cordon for gpu-perf-kernel-group at 2026-03-15T04:00Z

raj: Keep me posted. If we can't repro in-house we'll escalate to NVIDIA with logs and the nvidia-smi topo matrices. Ask for NCCL/driver pairing guidance for CUDA 13.2 + kernel 6.6.

maria: Will do. I'll paste the harvest tar and a short repro script here once ready. Thanks all for fast responses. :pray:

ken: FYI I'll prepare a small alert in console to flag sudden increases in NET transport usage vs SHM/NVLINK for top-50 jobs (cost and perf signal).

maria: Last note — jobs that hit NET fallback saw a cost bump in the billing plane due to increased egress between hosts. Ops, can we get a quick estimate of incremental cost yday midnight-04:00Z for that pool?

ops-bot: Billing query queued: estimate for us-west1-gpu-pool 2026-03-15T00:00Z-04:00Z will be posted in #finance in 15m.

alex: I'll start collecting the NCCL+topo repro logs now. If anyone can add node IDs of affected hosts (gpu-h100-11, gpu-a100-03) to the ticket, that helps.

maria: Adding node ids and I'll attach the harvest when ready. Thanks.
